subject: Publication objects for SyncGTM enrichments
body:
SyncGTM's docs enumerate 50+ data providers, 70+ enrichment fields and a 75+ action library. Across those lists there is no newsletter publication object, no article to publication attribution and no sponsor to publication pair, so a customer's own RSS feed or an AI scrape on their side is the only way newsletter text arrives, and it arrives without publication metadata.

NewsletterFIT supplies the metadata layer instead: publication identity, audience, topics, the sponsors running in it, momentum, and the article behind each fact. The reading is done by AI over the issue text, so the output is extracted entities and placements with a source URL and date.

That makes it an enrichment action rather than a corpus: query by domain or publication over REST, or through the MCP endpoint your action library can call.

I can send a sample of the fields and the export shape for one segment before anything is built.
